title: Lego says its Smart Brick is "here to stay" but "does not mean that we're leaving our core proposition behind", after criticism of abandoning non-digital play (Tom Phillips/IGN)
summary: Tom Phillips / IGN: Lego says its Smart Brick is “here to stay” but “does not mean that we're leaving our core proposition behind”, after criticism of abandoning non-digital play — “It's very important to be clear, this does not mean that we're leaving our core proposition behind.”
contentText:
Tom Phillips / IGN :

Lego says its Smart Brick is “here to stay” but “does not mean that we're leaving our core proposition behind”, after criticism of abandoning non-digital play   —  “It's very important to be clear, this does not mean that we're leaving our core proposition behind.”
